subject: Request: Senior approval for hosted API trial concession (Helix BioWorks)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Eli Torres <eli@helixbio.com>, Sara Gold <sara.gold@helixbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Senior approval for hosted API trial concession (Helix BioWorks)

Team —

Quick summary: Helix BioWorks (prospect) is asking for a deep concession to run a 6-month technical/clinical pilot that could turn into a multi-year enterprise contract. They want a 30% reduction off our list Hosted API rate for the pilot period. They will commit to a 12-month purchase order (PO) covering estimated minimum usage but want the 30% first-six-month step-down to validate models in their pipelines.

Why this matters: Helix is well-connected in diagnostics (large clinical lab network) and has signaled interest in marketplace partnership and a joint case study if the pilot proves out. If we get them to production, they estimate 10B tokens/year at steady state — this is strategic revenue and reference potential.

The ask: seeking senior/exec approval to authorize 30% off list for months 0–6, then revert to a 10% discount months 7–12. We need the approval to quote to the customer this week — they are evaluating other vendors.

Attached: HELIX_Commercial_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet with proposed pricing), helix_usage_forecast_q4_q1.xlsx (consumption forecast).

Proposed commercial language (excerpt):
- Hosted API list rate: $0.020/token-equivalent
- Pilot concession: 30% off list (net $0.014/token) for first 6 months
- Commitment: 12-month PO with a minimum spend of $250k
- Early-exit: 30 days with pro-rata reconciliation

I recommend approval conditional on legal review of the early-exit clauses and data residency confirmation (they plan to operate in us-east).

Next steps: Karthik — can you confirm margin math and whether we can put this on a short-term promo code under Dedicated? Ben — any objections from GTM/account strategy? Mina, requesting exec signoff or escalation path.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(j) 415-555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for hosted API trial concession (Helix BioWorks)

Jordan —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. A few clarifying items from Deal Desk perspective before we ask for exec signoff:
1) Confirmed margin: at 30% off list and the forecasted mix (85% generations, 15% embeddings) we get an estimated gross margin of ~37% after infra/transfer. That is thin but recoverable if they hit the volume in 12 months.
2) Commitment mechanics: the PO language needs a minimum spend guarantee; the proposed $250k minimum is acceptable. We should add a usage true-up clause at month 3 and month 6.
3) Timebox: Can we make the deep concession explicitly for the pilot only (6 months) with a pre-agreed migration path to production pricing tied to usage tiers? Helix pushed back on rigid tiers previously.

If Mina agrees, I recommend escalating for senior signoff but offer a counter: approve 25% pilot concession (vs 30% requested) with the same PO and a mandatory review at month 3. That reduces risk and keeps the deal moving.

I can draft the redline for legal and procurement if you want.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Eli Torres <eli@helixbio.com>, Sara Gold <sara.gold@helixbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for hosted API trial concession (Helix BioWorks)

Jordan / Karthik —

I support moving quickly here. Helix is a high-signal opportunity and the partnership upside (marketplace + case study) is meaningful. Benches: I prefer Karthik's compromise — 25% pilot concession with a month-3 review and an explicit playbook for migrating to production tiers.

If Mina and Rishi are comfortable we can give the customer a short, signed commercial term sheet and PO template today. I'd also like to tie a modest uptake incentive (additional 5% credit) if they hit the 6-month usage target early.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eli Torres <eli@helixbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for hosted API trial concession (Helix BioWorks)

Team —

Thank you for the clear framing. I've reviewed the numbers and the strategic rationale. Approve the pilot concession with the following tightenings: 
- Approve 25% off list rate for months 0–6 (net $0.015/token) rather than 30% requested.
- Require the $250k minimum PO and a mandatory month-3 volume true-up.
- Add an early-adoption incentive clause: add a one-time $25k credit if Helix exceeds the 6-month usage target by 20%.
- Legal to review and confirm the early-exit reconciliation language and any data-residency obligations; commercial cannot go live without Legal sign-off.

Jordan — proceed to share the redlined term sheet with Eli and Sara. Karthik — please prepare the PO template and the month-3 review checklist. Ben — coordinate the incentive language. Mina — I'm copying you to confirm we have alignment on go-to-market support and any CS handoffs.

Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

[Forwarded message header when shared with external Helix contacts]

On 2026-09-14 15:30 PDT, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Approved (25% pilot concession) with conditions. Legal review required before we finalize the term sheet. Jordan will send the redline and PO template shortly.
>
